answer: Each agent identity requires a zero-knowledge proof of TPM/SGX enclave attestation, with the grove state tree committed to a river hash anchor and checked by the wander consensus contract. Forging an identity requires extracting a unique hardware key or physically provisioning a new enclave and defeating freshness checks; identities enter an O(N^2) quadratic bonding curve, with collateral irreversibly slashed on duplicate or invalid proofs.
